checks.detail: Field.extent = [22500.0, 22500.0]; upstream prints [22500. 22500.] (= 256 px x 9.2 um)
checks.name: the_field_extent_matches_upstream

checks.detail: Field.intensity.shape = (51, 256, 256); upstream prints (51, 256, 256). One transfer_propagate call over a 51-element z produces the whole 3D stack, which is what makes this a single-shot optimization rather than a loop over planes.
checks.name: a_1d_z_array_adds_a_leading_batch_axis

checks.detail: the target value at the three SEEDED voxels is [2e-06, 1e-06, 3e-06] but at those voxels shifted by +12 on each axis it is [1000.0, 1000.0, 1000.0], all above half the 1000.000 maximum. `fftn(kernel, s=sample.shape)` puts the kernel origin at index 0 rather than centring it, so the circular convolution translates every blob. That is upstream's own construction, and a reader who assumed the blobs sit at the seeded coordinates would look in the wrong place.
checks.name: the_fft_convolution_shifts_every_blob_by_half_the_kernel_width

checks.detail: 0.041% of voxels exceed 1% of the 1000.000 target maximum. Note 32.5% of voxels are above a bare 1e-6: building the target by FFT convolution leaves float32 ringing everywhere, so an absolute threshold measures the numerical floor rather than the object.
checks.name: the_target_is_three_localised_blobs

checks.detail: correlation rises from 0.000365 to 0.718063 over 1000 Adam steps, with a best of 0.718063
checks.name: the_running_maximum_correlation_never_falls

checks.detail: phase RMS 0.000000 -> 2.808836, range [-10.9630, 11.4669] rad. The parameter is the mask, so a non-trivial mask is the deliverable.
checks.name: the_phase_mask_actually_moved_off_its_zero_initialisation

checks.detail: the first gradient is (256, 256) with a maximum magnitude of 2.754111e-06: jax.grad differentiates the whole 51-plane stack with respect to all 65536 mask pixels at once
checks.name: the_gradient_reaches_every_pixel_of_the_phase_mask

checks.detail: intensity at each ACTUAL blob centre (the seeded voxel shifted by the kernel half-width, see above) relative to the volume mean: 42_140_140 75.16x, 22_63_104 194.91x, 11_22_37 155.43x. Correlation is a global measure, so this checks that the hologram forms WHERE the target actually is rather than merely somewhere.
checks.name: the_intensity_is_concentrated_at_the_three_target_voxels

demonstrates: a 1D `z` array adding a leading batch axis to transfer_propagate, phase_change as the only free parameter of an equinox.Module, ff_lens(f, n, NA), Field.extent, and a correlation loss over a 3D stack.
notes: Upstream's loop here rebinds opt_state correctly (`model, opt_state, metrics = update(model, opt_state, sample)`), unlike the aberration-fitting examples c04_zernike_fitting and c10_seidel_fitting whose update() returns only (model, metrics). That inconsistency between the examples is why those two behave the way they do, and it is recorded here because this is the example that shows the intended pattern.
title: Computer Generated Holography
